reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fixed default retry policy to exclude retries on 503 which is potentially unsafe for idempotent requets", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The default retry policy no longer retries requests on 503 responses; set EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY to false to restore the old behavior (temporary flag).
consequence.remediation: Verify workloads relying on default 503 retries; set EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY=false if needed, knowing the flag will be removed.

proposed.statement: Istio's default retry policy no longer retries on 503; setting EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY to false reverts this, and the flag will be removed in future releases.
